evidence.description: Housing Ombudsman determination records the resident's complaint history, repair reports, and landlord response.

case.facts: The resident and her partner live in a 2-bedroom ground floor flat in a high-rise building. In February 2024 the landlord sent the resident notice of her new rent and service charges for the upcoming year. She queried the new charges in March 2024. The complaint is about the landlord’s response to the resident’s: Service charge queries. Reports of anti-social behaviour (ASB). Associated complaint.
